name: Skore Cool Sensation Lubricant Water Based 50ml | India
description:
Ignite passion and enhance intimacy with Skore Cool Cherry Flavoured Lube, a smooth, water-based lubricant designed to add flavor, fun, and comfort to your intimate moments. Perfect for oral, vaginal, and anal use, it’s gentle, safe, and easy to wash off.
